# MediVault Pro - Free MCCQE1 Question Bank

MediVault Pro is a comprehensive, free medical examination preparation platform specifically designed for International Medical Graduates (IMGs) preparing for the Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination Part I (MCCQE1).

## Core Resources
- [Q-Bank](https://dr1985404.github.io/): Over 6,000 exam-style multiple-choice questions with detailed rationales.
- [High-Yield Notes](https://dr1985404.github.io/high-yield-mccqe1.html): Structured clinical summaries covering all major medical specialties.
- [CDM Cases](https://dr1985404.github.io/clinical-decision-making.html): Interactive cases focused on clinical reasoning.
- [Ethics & Law](https://dr1985404.github.io/ethics-mccqe1.html): Specialized prep for Canadian medical legal standards.

## Specialties
- [Internal Medicine](https://dr1985404.github.io/internal-medicine-mccqe1.html)
- [Surgery](https://dr1985404.github.io/surgery-mccqe1.html)
- [Pediatrics](https://dr1985404.github.io/pediatrics-mccqe1.html)
- [Psychiatry](https://dr1985404.github.io/psychiatry-mccqe1.html)
